tasks.description: Prisma: add ReportStatus enum, Conversation, ConversationParticipant, Message, MessageAttachment, MessageRevision, MessageReport, MessagingSettings, PendingMessageEmail, User.isSafeguardingLead and all back-relations (User, FileObject) with the indexes in system-design §2; write migration 20261112000000_add_direct_messaging and run prisma generate

Shared limits (BODY_MAX, COUNTER_FROM, MAX_FILES, MAX_PARTICIPANTS, EDIT_WINDOW_MS, THREAD_POLL_MS, LIST_POLL_MS, PAGE_SIZE) and all Zod schemas from system-design §3.2, mirroring api-contracts.json components

Contact rules: pure canMessageWith + loadRelations batch loader (teacherId OR coTeacherIds, ACTIVE enrollments, current-year homeroom, ParentStudentLink, ACTIVE recipients), canMessage, messageableIds, validateNewConversation (2..25, student group needs staff), canSendIn (A4 rule); table-driven unit test over full role×role matrix
Access helpers: getParticipation (404 when missing or leftAt set), requireSafeguardingLead (ADMIN + DB-read flag, 403), requirePageSafeguardingLead (redirect /forbidden)
Notification plumbing: register message.received and message.reported types (COMMUNICATION); add optional NotifyInput.inApp (default true) to notify() — existing callers unchanged
Quiet hours: pure isInQuietHours (wraps midnight) and quietHoursEnd (fromZonedTime), getSettings/putSettings (both-or-neither, start≠end); unit test incl. DST and edge minutes

Messaging notifications + deferred email: conversationLink, onMessageSent (collapse unread message.received, in-app notify, create-only PendingMessageEmail upsert, skip muted/left), onMessageReported; processPendingMessageEmails (claim-by-delete, read/muted/left drop, quiet-hours re-defer, notify inApp:false, ≤200/run); hook into dispatch route in its own try/catch with messageEmails summary

Message service: listMessages keyset (before | after+since → {messages, changed}, deleted redaction), sendMessage + exported send-transaction helper (rate limit, participation, canSendIn, attachment ownership ≤5, link files, bump lastMessageAt, sender lastReadAt, unarchive others, after-commit onMessageSent), editMessage (MessageRevision in tx) and soft deleteMessage within 15 min

Conversation service: listConversations (lastMessageAt desc, preview, LATERAL unread count ≤99, archived/q filters), createConversation (validateNewConversation, involvesStudent, first message via send helper), getConversation (canSend/canLeave), markRead (also marks notification read + deletes PendingMessageEmail), setMuted, setArchived, leave (ONE_TO_ONE / CREATOR_OF_STUDENT_GROUP refusals), unreadCount raw COUNT
Register 'message' file-access context: participant not left, or ADMIN safeguarding lead (DB read); deny on error

Contacts service: listContacts(user, q) builds labelled groups (My teachers, My child's teachers (<child>), Students in <course>, Parents of students in <course>, Homeroom <section>, Staff, School office) from contact-rules relation queries, q filter, cap 50/group

Reports + safeguarding services: reportMessage (participant, not sender, 409 on duplicate OPEN, after-commit onMessageReported); listReports, getReport (±5 msgs incl. deleted + revisions, audited), reviewReport (note required for review, 409 if not OPEN, audited), searchConversations (involvesStudent only), getConversationForSafeguarding (404 if !involvesStudent, audit every call)
Conversation API routes (thin withHandler → auth → parse → service): GET/POST /api/conversations, GET /api/conversations/:id, GET/POST /api/conversations/:id/messages, POST read/mute/archive/leave

Message, messaging and settings API routes: PATCH/DELETE /api/messages/:id, POST /api/messages/:id/report, GET /api/messaging/unread-count, GET /api/messaging/contacts, GET/PUT /api/me/messaging-settings
Safeguarding API routes: GET /api/safeguarding/reports, GET/PATCH /api/safeguarding/reports/:id, GET /api/safeguarding/conversations, GET /api/safeguarding/conversations/:id
isSafeguardingLead on PATCH /api/users/:id: add to updateUserSchema; updateUser rejects true for non-ADMIN (400 VALIDATION_ERROR) and audits the change in user.update metadata

Seed: Alice Admin safeguarding lead; upsert Pat↔Sam ParentStudentLink; idempotent threads Pat↔Tom (6), Tom + 4 MATH-7A students (3), Tina↔Tom (4), student↔teacher thread with one OPEN report; logger.warn skip on missing prerequisites

Inbox client foundation: usePolling hook (pauses on document.hidden, fires on visibilitychange), MessagesLayout (two panes, single pane + back IconButton below 768px), ConversationList (Inbox/Archived tabs, search, Badge unread, 30s poll). Look up every MUI component via mui-mcp first

Thread client: MessageThread (day dividers in school tz, FileList, edited/deleted states, IntersectionObserver load-older with stable scroll, 5s after+since poll, POST /read on new visible messages, per-message edit/delete/report Menu + toast), Composer (Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, FileUpload context 'message' ≤5, counter >4500, disabled when !canSend), ConversationMenu (mute, archive, participants Dialog, leave ConfirmDialog hidden when !canLeave)

NewConversationDialog: Autocomplete multiple + groupBy over /api/messaging/contacts, subject ≤120, first message, initialRecipients and optional group restriction props; navigates to /messages/<id> on success
Messages pages: server shells calling requirePageUser rendering MessagesLayout with ConversationList, MessageThread/Composer/ConversationMenu and the new-conversation button

Navigation + unread badge: NavItem.badge/requires, Messages (all roles, badge 'messages') and Safeguarding (ADMIN, requires safeguardingLead) items, navigationForRole(role, flags); (app)/layout.tsx reads isSafeguardingLead and passes to shell; shell renders MessagesNavBadge (30s poll of unread-count)

Student page + roster entry points: new students/[id]/layout.tsx (keeps [id] segment) rendering StudentMessageActions ('Message parents' for TEACHER/ADMIN hidden without linked parents; 'Message teacher' for PARENT restricted to My child's teachers group); roster page moves staff table into client RosterTable with Checkbox selection + 'Message selected students'
Quiet hours UI: QuietHoursSection (two TextField type=time, Save, Clear) on /account/notifications

Safeguarding UI: /admin/safeguarding page (requirePageSafeguardingLead, Tabs Reports/Conversations, ?report= opens drawer), SafeguardingReports and SafeguardingConversations (DataTable + detail Drawer, Mark reviewed with note / Dismiss), read-only audited conversation view page showing deleted bodies and revisions

Integration tests: notification collapse, muted skip, rate limit 429, non-participant/left 404, edit revision + 15-min window, duplicate report 409; deferred email read short-circuit and quiet-hours deferral; safeguarding 403 for non-leads and audit row on view
E2E: parent→teacher round trip in two browser contexts (appears < 6s); student→student absent from picker and POST returns 403
